ingredients.raw: 15 oz. garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: garbanzo beans

ingredients.raw: 5-6 mini cucumbers, sliced into half moons (1 large cucumber will work, too)
ingredients.name: mini cucumbers

ingredients.raw: ½ teaspoon everything bagel seasoning + more, to taste
ingredients.name: everything bagel seasoning

instructions.text: Add the garbanzo beans, tomatoes, onion, and cucumbers to a bowl and toss to combine. Drizzle the ingredients with the balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and lemon juice. Toss again.
Season with salt, pepper, and everything bagel seasoning and toss.
Serve the salad over ⅓ cup of cottage cheese. Season with more everything bagel seasoning, to taste.
